tools.name: get_call_rates
tools.description: Current eFon per-minute prices (EUR and USD) for calling a country: every rate line (mobile / landline / specific networks or regions), the cheapest price, any announced price change, the country page URL and app download links. Rates are the same wherever the caller is. Use this for "how much does

tools.name: compare_call_rates
tools.description: Cheapest eFon per-minute price (EUR and USD) for several countries at once, sorted from cheapest to most expensive, each with its country page URL. Use this when the user calls more than one country ("rates to India, Pakistan and Bangladesh", "which is cheaper to call, Mexico or Colombia?").

tools.name: how_to_call
tools.description: Dialing instructions for calling a destination country from an origin country: exit code, country code, example mobile and landline numbers written the way to dial them, the time difference and the hours when it is daytime on both ends, plus the eFon guide URL and the cheapest eFon rate. Omit origin

tools.name: lookup_calling_code
tools.description: Reverse lookup of an international dialing code: which country (or countries, for shared codes like +1, +7 or +44) a code such as +36, 0036 or +1 876 belongs to, with capital, example number and the eFon rate page. Use this for "which country is +36", "who is calling me from +233", "what does 00252

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_calling_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
